Detector.Details: Detects ThreadLocal values that are installed but not removed before the logical method scope exits.

BugPattern.ShortDescription: ThreadLocal value may not be removed
BugPattern.LongDescription: ThreadLocal value is installed but no matching cleanup operation is found.
BugPattern.Details: This warning approximates Scope-Cleanup Omission. A ThreadLocal value written in a request, task, or callback context may survive on a reused worker thread if remove() or an equivalent cleanup operation is missing.

BugPattern.ShortDescription: Static ThreadLocal may pin application-defined values
BugPattern.LongDescription: Static ThreadLocal may retain application-defined values across deployment lifetime.
BugPattern.Details: This warning approximates Class-Loader Pinning. Static ThreadLocal fields or static holders can keep application-defined objects reachable through container-managed threads and may prevent class unloading.

BugPattern.ShortDescription: ThreadLocal context propagation may be unbalanced
BugPattern.LongDescription: ThreadLocal context is installed across an async boundary without guaranteed restoration.
BugPattern.Details: This warning approximates Context-Propagation Mismatch. A wrapper installs ThreadLocal context before delegated execution but does not restore the previous value on all paths.

BugPattern.LongDescription: ThreadLocal stores heavyweight or growth-prone values without clear bounding or cleanup.
BugPattern.Details: This warning approximates Heavyweight-Value Retention. ThreadLocal values such as arrays, buffers, builders, parsers, serializers, or compression state may retain peak-size memory on long-lived workers.

Detector.Details: Detects static ThreadLocal fields or static holders.
Detects unbalanced ThreadLocal context propagation across async boundaries.
Detects ThreadLocal fields with heavyweight or growth-prone value types.
